title: 第七章 合作
content_zh:
话音落下，
冉青墨看着眼前男子俊美而认真的面容，从眼神完全看不出她此刻在思索些什么。
许元没有催促，安静的等待着对方的答复。
没有人想死，他也不列外。
原身这位三公子家里虽然权倾整个大炎，但远水解不了近渴。
在现在这种孤立无援的近况下，许元能够依靠的人，反而只有眼前这位将他绑出来的冉青墨。
其他人都想杀他，但她，仅仅是绑票。
焱灵蟒死后鲜血汩汩涌出，鲜血如同岩浆般灼热，在阴冷的冬雨中掀起阵阵水雾，将洞外一切萧瑟阻隔在外。
沉默间，
“好，你说。”
冉青墨清淡的声音缓缓响起在安静的山洞。
许元略微松了一口气。
他真的有些害怕在这个时候，对方再给她一棍子。
斟酌用词，许元望着她，轻声道：
“冉先生，我想说的很简单，为了我的命，以及你的命，我们最好合作。”
冉青墨静静看着他，等着他接下来的话语。
许元见状，接着说道：
“我知道现在以我这阶下囚说这话有些许的僭越，但是刚才冉先生你也看到了，生性怕死至极的焱灵蟒冒死也想要袭杀我，背后必然有人在捣鬼。如果我在这里死了，我父亲不可能会放过你。”
顿了顿，
许元一字一顿：

“你也会死。”
眼前这位总是一袭黑衣示人，性淡如水的女子真的很强。
但这方世界强的人却不止她一人，抓了许长天导致他身死，便是她死亡的开端。
在《沧源》中，许元其实蛮喜欢冉青墨这个角色的。
她算是半个女主角，之所以算是半个，因为她每次都会死在与玩家互生情愫之前，连面纱都未曾摘下便会匆匆死去。
在《沧源》二十五个结局之中，冉青墨只有一条远遁海外的官方彩蛋，不过达成这条彩蛋的前提条件却是要玩家主动开挂。
把属性刷到上限，强行击败一个在当时玩家百分百不可能击败的BOSS，方才能救下她。
曾经许元觉得这个彩蛋很有趣。
角色的命运会因玩家做出的选择而改变，但这份改变的作用却是有限，除非你开挂。
但如今忽然觉得对方和他这原身也算是某种意义上的卧龙凤雏了，二十五条世界线死二十五次。
冉青墨没有说话，露出的一双眸子也没有丝毫情绪波动。
对于许元说出的死亡威胁，没有丝毫的动摇。
许元意识到这种说法似乎对于冉青墨这样的女子行不通，深吸一口气，忽然道：
“冉先生，你抓我是为了剑宗那四万弟子，对吧？”
冉青墨眼神动了动，洞内温暖的空气仿佛也随之下降了些许。
许元见状心中了然，继续低声说道：
“你不用这么看我，我不询问你的消息来源，你也不别探寻我这个废物是如何得知这个消息，现在我们在一条船上，深究没有任何意义。”
冉青墨眸中眼神松了一瞬。
许元看着一眼外面的巨蟒尸体，缓声说道：
“虽然我现在依旧不认同你那抓了我就能要挟我父亲的判断，但是我想就算你想要挟他，最起码也不能用一具尸体去吧？”

冉青墨沉默两秒，掩面的黑纱之下传来她清脆的声音：
“可是，你没有炁。”
许元闻言一愣，但转瞬便明了对
方意思。
在这方超凡世界中，没有炁就等于普通人。
而普通人在冉青墨这个层次的修行者眼中，与蚂蚁几乎没有任何区别。
冉青墨说这话，不是指许元提出合作的不自量力，而是单纯在诉说一个事实。
若是真的有第三方势力敢在她面前对许元下手，那么实力自然是不会弱的。
等她和对方打起来，光是余波就够许元死上一百次了。
现在她本身就要保护许元，合作与否根本没有任何必要。
许元本身就没有想要介入战斗的意思，直接低声问道：
“你有这万兴山脉的地图么？”
冉青墨眨了眨眼，直接转身去山洞最里面的那个行囊带中一通翻找，拿着一卷羊皮卷便走了过来，递给许元。
许元盘坐而下，将羊皮卷在篝火旁
看到地图的那一瞬，许元略微松了一口气。
虽然在细节上有些出入，但这份地图与《沧源》的游戏中万兴山脉的地图大体却是一致的。
顿了顿，
许元向着冉青墨招了招手，示意她也坐下：
“小时候，我父亲曾经带我和哥哥一起来过这万兴山脉，只要你能确认我们在哪，我能提供一个藏身的地方。”
冉青墨缓缓撩起黑衣，坐到了许愿身旁，但看向许元的眼神却有些警惕。

许元也发现了自己话里的不妥。
虽然做事有点呆，但冉青墨应该不傻。
垂眸看着地图，略微斟酌，许元随口说道：
“我知道现在这万兴山脉里肯定也有我父亲的人在找我，但其实你也不必顾虑太多。
“因为我联系不上他们，在你这种修行者面前，我做什么都是透明的。
“相反，如果你继续带着我在这万兴山脉里乱窜，反而很有可能被发现。”
许元侧眸对上了她清幽的眸子，声音依旧有些沙哑：
“你可以遮掩气息，但我不行。”
和众多超凡世界一样，这里的修行者是可以用气机找人。
冉青墨眸子目露思索良久，最终还是轻轻颔首，很认真的说道：
“我会看着你。”
许元微微一笑，
“你随意。”
许元又将目光落在摊开的地图上，细声说道：
“小时候，我父亲带我和两个哥哥来过这万兴山脉，他在这里有一处洞府，里面有很多修行资源，够我们两人在里面生活一段很长的时间。”
这话是许元编的，他那便宜老爹可不知道这处宝地，但并不影响他把这口锅往对方身上扣。
反正冉青墨也不可能找对方当面对质。
冉青墨闻言黛眉微颦，声音清冷： “你父亲也知道？”
许元对此早已做好腹稿，毫不在意的回道：
“现在我父亲他得坐镇帝京，不可能亲自来找我，他手下的人不可能知道那里。而且就算知道那处洞府，冉先生你觉得他们有多大的概率会去那里找我？”

“.......”冉青墨沉默。
许元轻轻在羊皮卷上点了点：
“好了，你把我们所在的在这里指出来吧，然后尽快赶路。”
冉青墨闻言轻轻点了点头，一双美眸微微垂下。
盯着地图看了半晌，她才有些犹豫的伸出一根纤纤玉指轻轻一点。
许元见了，狭长的眸子微微一眯。
但还未来得及高兴，
下一刻，
他便看到那根纤长细腻的手指又动了动，在另外一边点了点。
“........”
许元沉默着抬头，有些欲言又止。
冉青墨抬眸对上了许元那无语的眼神。
无声对视，
冉青墨第一次错开了视线，低下头：
“我...我不知道。”
content_en:
The words fell,
Ran Qingmo looked at the handsome and serious face of the man in front of her, and it was impossible to tell from her eyes what she was thinking about at the moment.
Xu Yuan did not urge him, but quietly waited for the other party's reply.
No one wants to die, including him.
Although this third young master originally had all the power in the family, water from afar could not quench his thirst for nearness.
In this current situation of isolation and helplessness, the only person Xu Yuan can rely on is Ran Qingmo, who kidnapped him.
Everyone else wanted to kill him, but she just kidnapped him.
After the Yanling python died, blood gushes out. The blood is as hot as magma, setting off waves of mist in the cold winter rain, blocking out all the desolation outside the cave.
in silence,
"Okay, you say."
Ran Qingmo's light voice slowly sounded in the quiet cave.
Xu Yuan breathed a sigh of relief.
He was really afraid that at this moment, the other party would give her another stick.
After considering his words, Xu Yuan looked at her and said softly:
"Mr. Ran, what I want to say is very simple. For my life and your life, we'd better cooperate."
Ran Qingmo looked at him quietly, waiting for his next words.
Seeing this, Xu Yuan continued:
"I know it's a bit presumptuous for a prisoner like me to say this, but as you saw just now, Mr. Ran, the Yanling Python, which is extremely afraid of death, risked his own life to kill me. There must be someone behind it. If I die here, there is no way my father will let you go."
After a pause,
Xu Yuan said word for word:
"You will die too."
The woman in front of me, who always wears black clothes and shows off her temperament, is really strong.
But she was not the only powerful person in this world. Catching Xu Changtian and causing his death was the beginning of her death.
In "Cang Yuan", Xu Yuan actually liked the role of Ran Qingmo.
She is half a heroine, and the reason why she is half is because she dies every time before she can fall in love with the player, and dies in a hurry without even taking off her veil.
Among the twenty-five endings of "Cang Yuan", there is only one official easter egg for Ran Qingmo to escape overseas, but the prerequisite for achieving this easter egg is that the player must take the initiative to cheat.
Only by raising her attributes to the upper limit and forcibly defeating a BOSS that was 100% impossible for players to defeat at that time could she be saved.
Xu Yuan once thought this easter egg was very interesting.
The fate of the character will change based on the choices made by the player, but the effect of this change is limited unless you cheat.
But now I suddenly feel that the other person and his original body can be regarded as sleeping dragons and phoenixes in a sense, dying twenty-five times in twenty-five world lines.
Ran Qingmo said nothing, and his exposed eyes showed no emotion at all.
There was no wavering at all about Xu Yuan's death threat.
Xu Yuan realized that this argument did not seem to work for a woman like Ran Qingmo. He took a deep breath and suddenly said:
"Mr. Ran, you arrested me because of the 40,000 disciples of the Sword Sect, right?"
Ran Qingmo's eyes moved, and the warm air in the cave seemed to drop a little.
Seeing this, Xu Yuan understood clearly and continued to whisper:
"You don't have to look at me like that. I won't ask you about the source of the information, and you don't want to find out how I, a loser, got the news. We are on the same boat now, and there is no point in delving into it."
Ran Qingmo's eyes relaxed for a moment.
Xu Yuan glanced at the giant python corpse outside and said slowly:
"Although I still don't agree with your judgment that if you catch me, you can blackmail my father, but I think even if you want to blackmail him, at least you can't use a corpse, right?"
Ran Qingmo was silent for two seconds, and her clear voice came from under the black veil covering her face:
"But you don't have Qi."
Xu Yuan was stunned for a moment when he heard this, but in an instant he understood what he meant.
Fang means.
In this extraordinary world, those without Qi are just like ordinary people.
In the eyes of a practitioner at Ran Qingmo's level, ordinary people are almost as good as ants.There is no difference.
When Ran Qingmo said this, he did not mean that Xu Yuan was overestimating his capabilities when proposing cooperation, but simply stating a fact.
If there is really a third party force that dares to attack Xu Yuan in front of her, then its strength will naturally not be weak.
When she fights with the other party, the aftermath alone is enough to kill Xu Yuan a hundred times.
Now she has to protect Xu Yuan herself, and there is no need to cooperate or not.
Xu Yuan himself had no intention of intervening in the battle, so he directly asked in a low voice:
"Do you have a map of the Wanxing Mountains?"
Ran Qingmo blinked, turned around and rummaged through the luggage belt at the end of the cave. He came over with a parchment scroll and handed it to Xu Yuan.
Xu Yuan sat down cross-legged and rolled up the sheepskin beside the bonfire.
The moment he saw the map, Xu Yuan breathed a sigh of relief.
Although there are some differences in details, this map is generally consistent with the Wanxing Mountains map in the "Cangyuan" game.
After a pause,
Xu Yuan waved to Ran Qingmo and motioned for her to sit down too:
"When I was young, my father once took me and my brother to the Wanxing Mountains. As long as you can confirm where we are, I can provide a hiding place."
Ran Qingmo slowly lifted up his black clothes and sat next to Xu Yuan, but his eyes when looking at Xu Yuan were a little wary.
Xu Yuan also discovered that there was something wrong with his words.
Although he is a bit dull in his work, Ran Qingmo should not be stupid.
Xu Yuan lowered his eyes and looked at the map, considered it for a moment, and said casually:
"I know there must be people from my father looking for me in the Wanxing Mountains, but actually you don't have to worry too much.
"Because I can't contact them, everything I do is transparent in front of a practitioner like you.
"On the contrary, if you continue to lead me around the Wanxing Mountains, you are very likely to be discovered."
Xu Yuan's side eyes met her quiet eyes, his voice was still a little hoarse:
"You can hide your aura, but I can't."
Like many otherworldly worlds, practitioners here can use Qi machines to find people.
Ran Qingmo thought for a long time with his eyes open, and finally nodded gently and said seriously:
"I'll watch you."
Xu Yuan smiled slightly,
"As you wish."
Xu Yuan cast his eyes on the spread map again and whispered:
"When I was young, my father took my two brothers and me to the Wanxing Mountains. He had a cave here with many cultivation resources, enough for the two of us to live there for a long time."
Xu Yuan made this up. His cheap dad didn't know about this treasure, but it didn't stop him from putting the blame on the other party.
Anyway, it was impossible for Ran Qingmo to confront the other party.
Ran Qingmo frowned slightly when he heard this, and said in a cold voice: "Your father also knows?"
Xu Yuan had already prepared a plan for this and replied nonchalantly:
"Now that my father has to sit in the Imperial Capital, he cannot come to me personally, and his people cannot know where it is. And even if they know the cave, Mr. Ran, what do you think is the chance that they will go there to find me?"
"..." Ran Qingmo was silent.
Xu Yuan lightly tapped on the parchment:
"Okay, please point out where we are, and then get on your way as quickly as possible."
Ran Qingmo nodded slightly when he heard the words, and his beautiful eyes lowered slightly.
After staring at the map for a long time, she hesitated and stretched out a slender jade finger to tap lightly.
When Xu Yuan saw it, his narrow eyes narrowed slightly.
But I haven’t had time to be happy yet,
The next moment,
He then saw the long and delicate finger move again, tapping on the other side.
"..."
Xu Yuan raised his head in silence, hesitating to speak.
Ran Qingmo raised his eyes and met Xu Yuan's speechless eyes.
Looking at each other silently,
Ran Qingmo looked away for the first time and lowered his head:
"I...I don't know."
